Beefchoplets and BiscuitTurtleKid |difficulty = Normal |length_measurement = 00:51.78 |wave_structure = Normal |rewards = {{RewardsList|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Winter Bridges''' is, as the name suggests, a winter [[Maps|map]]. ==Design & Path== {{Tabber |Current |The current version of '''Winter Bridges''' is surrounded by mountains. Snowflakes can be seen falling from the sky. The main area of the map is split into three parts by a small river. All these parts are connected by bridges. Some wooden houses, wintry trees, lampposts, rocks and small hills can be seen. A railroad can also be seen. It is blocked by a fallen tree. The stone path starts and ends at a cave. The path takes several turns and crosses one of the bridges. |Version 3 |The third version of '''Winter Bridges''' had two snowy main islands and another large iceberg island, each with slate bridges linking all of them together. On the bridges were red and green strips decorating them. A river separated the islands and icebergs could be seen in the river. Some igloos, wintry trees, lampposts with wraiths, signs and an outhouse could be seen. A railroad could also be seen, with a wooden station being seen on the first island. The white slate path began and ended at two caves. The path took several corners on all three islands, spanning two bridges. |Version 2 |The second version of '''Winter Bridges''' is identical to the third version, except that the skybox was brighter. |Version 1 |The first version of '''Winter Bridges''' is identical to the third version, except a baseplate frozen lake surrounded the map, instead of terrain water, and the skybox was brighter. }} ==Interactive Map== {{Tabber |Current |{{Map:WinterBridgesV4}} |Version 3 |{{Map:Winter Bridges}} }} ==Rewards== The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map. Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal. {{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}} ==Strategy== *There are multiple cliff spots scattered across the map. **The cliff spot near the river on the first part of the island is the best spot on the map, as it allows cliff towers to cover most of path. *Ground towers should be placed around the entrance. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Map Icons}} Winter Bridges.png|First & second version (1 January 2020 – 12 March 2022) WinterBridgesV3Icon.png|Third versionThis icon was not used in-game. Instead, the outdated icon for the first and second versions of the map was used. An updated icon was specifically made for the wiki. WinterBridgesDI1.png|Current version on a development image. }} ==Trivia== *Before the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], '''Winter Bridges''' was a very bright map due to an oversight, which could have caused a loss in focus because of the intensity of the brightness. **This bug was later fixed on 12th of March 2022. *This was originally called "''Winter Lights''", before being remade to remove most of the Christmas themes to make it more of a purely winter-themed map. **It was also a nighttime map, instead of a daytime map. This would later change on 12th of March 2022, turning it into a nighttime map again. *A small model of Azuc's character could have been found under the bridge of the first three versions of the map, fishing underwater. He is wearing the [[w:c:Roblox:Catalog:White Banded Red Top Hat|White Banded Red Top Hat]], a hat given out to developers who have helped created an official Roblox event. ==Update History== *'''1 January 2020''' - [[Release v1.5|Release v1.5.1]] **'''Winter Bridges''' added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **{{Color|Normal}} difficulty added. **Baseplate water replaced with terrain water. **No longer gives a badge upon first triumph. **{{Bug}} '''Winter Bridges''' is very bright. *'''12 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]] **'''Winter Bridges''' remade. **{{Bugfix}} '''Winter Bridges''' is no longer very bright. *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Winter Bridges''' remade. **[[Enemies Beta]] modifier added. **{{Bug}} Cliffs are not highlighted. *'''9 January 2023''' - [[v1.6.0]]f **{{Bugfix}} Cliffs are now highlighted. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **[[Enemies Beta]] removed. ==Notes== {{MapNavBox}}
